attchmntText: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript.
voiceSummary: Hindalco Industries Limited filed the transcript of its Second Quarter Earnings Conference Call for FY27 held on November 6, 2026, with the BSE, NSE, and Luxembourg Stock Exchange. The company reported consolidated EBITDA of INR13,869 crores, up 52% year-on-year, and profit after tax of INR7,533 crores, up 59% year-on-year. India upstream aluminium shipments increased 1% year-on-year, while revenues rose 33%. Novelis, aluminium downstream, and copper businesses contributed INR6,860 crores to earnings. Management highlighted safety improvements, sustainability initiatives including 643 MW of renewable energy capacity, and a global aluminium market deficit. The filing was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Hindalco Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about the investor meeting at the CITIC Securities CLSA 29th India Forum 2026 to be attended by Hindalco Industries Limited.
voiceSummary: Hindalco Industries Limited intimates that its representatives will participate in investor meetings at the CITIC Securities CLSA 29th India Forum 2026 on November 17, 2026. The event runs from 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. at Hotel Trident, Nariman Point, Mumbai. Meetings include one-on-one, two-on-one, and group sessions. The schedule may change due to organizer or company exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these interactions. Investor presentations for Q2FY27 Earnings and Investor Day 2025 dated April 1, 2025, are available on the company website www.hindalco.com.

voiceSummary: Hindalco Industries Limited published its unaudited consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported revenue from operations of 1,76,533 crore for the six months ended September 30, 2026. Profit for the period was 14,646 crore. Earnings per share stood at 65.51. The results were approved by the Board of Directors on November 5, 2026. ESDS Software Solution Limited issued a notice for its 21st Annual General Meeting on November 30, 2026. The meeting will be conducted through video conferencing. E-voting is available from November 26, 2026, to November 29, 2026. NABKISAN FINANCE LIMITED reported total income from operations of 35,309.10 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. Net profit after tax was 7,314.00 lakhs.
